name: Iceglide
body:
School transmutation [cold]; Level alchemist 4, bloodrager 4, druid 4, shaman 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S

Range touch

Target creature touched

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

The target can pass through ice or snow as easily as a fish swims through water, traveling at a speed of 15 feet. This movement leaves behind no tunnel or hole, nor does it create any ripple or other sign of its presence. It requires as much concentration as walking, so the subject can attack or cast spells normally, but cannot charge or run. This spell does not give the target the ability to breathe while submerged in the ice or snow, so when passing through solid material, the creature must hold its breath.
